title: Research Lab ExperimentSpec Schema v2
description: Candidate JSON Schema definition for Phase 0 ExperimentSpec contract in AI Quant Research Lab (Protocol v2, status: DRAFT_UNFROZEN). ExperimentSpec defines PREDICTIVE INTENT and methodology specification only (methods, parameters, logical data requirements, validation boundaries, and cost models). It strictly forbids runtime facts, execution artifacts, worker details, and evaluation assessments.

decimal_string.description: Canonical Decimal representation aligned with research-json-v1: no leading/trailing decimal zeroes, no exponent, no positive sign, no negative zero.

iso_timestamp_micros.description: Strict UTC ISO-8601 timestamp with microsecond resolution (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.ffffffZ).

nullable_sha256_hash.description: Nullable 64-character lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest (null only in unexecuted drafts).

dataset_reference_uri.description: Logical catalog identifier only; not a physical file, host or network locator.

failure_action.description: Data defects are observed facts, not failure to execute an audit.

parameters.description: Planned explicit overrides; names, types, units and omitted defaults must match the versioned method definition. Run records all resolved defaults.
